subject: game-production-runner in-flight artifact-cache leases

cache.production.lease.ledger: one cache-local JSONL ledger per digest-bound run owner
sealed digest chain with ACQUIRED, RENEWED, PROTECTED, and RELEASED events
maximum 10000 events and 16 MiB per ledger

cache.production.lease.owner-session-bin: cache root, job root, run id, plan, and start time are stored only as digests
newer same-run acquisition fences older session handles
digest binding is continuity evidence, not principal authentication

cache.production.lease.bounded-deadline: duration covers cache-hit verification plus executor and verifier fallback for every remaining attempt, with margin
no daemon, heartbeat, renewal timer, or background scan

cache.production.lease.crash-recovery: abrupt exit leaves the last event intact
active protection is time-derived and disappears after expiry without ledger rewrite
same owner can append a recovery renewal

cache.production.lease.runner-lifecycle: cache-enabled runner acquires before package cache access
exact key protected before load or publish
release appended only after terminal receipt or graceful checkpoint persistence
unexpected throw relies on bounded expiry

cache.production.lease.discovery: maximum 20000 directory entries, 10000 ledgers, 100000 events, and 64 MiB aggregate
invalid, linked, malformed, or over-limit evidence holds retention

cache.production.retention.lease-binding: apply freshly rescans stable lease snapshot before mutation
released and expired leases grant no protection

cache.production.retention.key-coordinat: runner key protection and final retention check-delete use the same atomic cache-local key lock
busy or changed coordination state deletes nothing for that key
scope is the governed retention path, not direct explicit human invalidation

cache.production.lease.checkpoint-handof: graceful checkpoint is sealed before lease release
checkpoint-derived exact reference remains protected by retention

outOfScopeGaps: released and expired lease-ledger curation or compaction
